newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria 2-yr T-note offer remains unsold.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria 2-yr T-note offer remains unsold.

text.p: Bulgaria's Finance Ministry offer of 500 million levs of two-year floater coupon T-notes was not sold after the ministry rejected the average price of bids as too low, the Bulgarian National Bank (BNB) said on Monday.
The issue was offered with no minimum acceptable price set in advance by the ministry for Friday's auction.
The semi-annual coupon equals the BNB's central interest rate (CIR) for the period to maturity. The CIR is now set at 15 percent monthly or 180 percent annually.
One financial institution took part in the auction, the BNB said. In line with its usual practice the BNB did not say which this institution was.
